build_system: pip install -e . (pyproject.toml with setuptools build backend)
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio, asyncio_mode=auto, FastAPI TestClient for integration tests
verification_instructions: Run pytest tests/ -v after each feature. All tests must pass. For database features, verify: (1) Tables exist in tutorial_prod via psql $DATABASE_URL_TUTORIAL -c '\dt project_ai_*', (2) python -m app.main starts without errors and GET /health returns 200, (3) Workflow persists across service restart with same contract_sha256
snapshot_or_generated_files: None - database tables are persistent, no generated files to commit
environment_constraints: Database operations are async (use AsyncEngine, AsyncSession from SQLAlchemy async). MANDATORY: Use existing tutorial_prod PostgreSQL database (DATABASE_URL_TUTORIAL environment variable). PROHIBITED: SQLite (sqlite, aiosqlite, :memory:), new database creation (project_ai_prod, project_ai.db). Test database must be PostgreSQL (tutorial_test or test schema). Always use PostgreSQL-specific SQL (ON CONFLICT, JSONB) not SQLite SQL (INSERT OR IGNORE, JSON).
contribution_requirements: Per docs/governance/CONTRIBUTING.md: type hints required, docstrings for public APIs, test coverage 80%+. Python specific: no 'any' types, strict boolean checks, await all promises, complexity <20.
key_patterns: Existing patterns: (1) Pydantic BaseModel for domain models (app/models/*.py), (2) Dataclass for internal state (ProjectLLMWorkflow, StateTransition), (3) FastAPI dependency injection (Depends()), (4) async/await throughout, (5) In-memory dict stores at module level (contracts_store, _candidates_store - TO BE REPLACED), (6) TestClient(app) for integration tests with fixtures per file, (7) No conftest.py currently - FEAT-004 creates it with PostgreSQL fixtures. FEAT-000 will discover existing Drizzle patterns in packages/db-tutorial/src/schema/
directory_structure: services/project-ai/: app/ (main.py, api/routes/, models/, contracts/, orchestration/, database/ [NEW in FEAT-001]), tests/ (test_*.py files, conftest.py [NEW in FEAT-004]), pyproject.toml, README.md. NEW database/ module: __init__.py, session.py, models.py, repositories.py, repositories_impl.py, exceptions.py, dependencies.py. Existing packages/db-tutorial/: drizzle.config.ts, src/schema/ (Drizzle table definitions), migrations/ (Drizzle migration SQL files). Project AI adds project_ai_* tables to existing tutorial_prod database.
